tool.help:
About Scop3P and the Scop3P Toolkit ===================================
The Scop3P toolkit is a set of tools for exploring and extending Scop3P features written as a Shiny App in Python.
Scop3P: Phosphosites on Protein 3D Structure --------------------------------------------
Scop3P provides a unique and powerful resource for exploring and understanding the impact of phosphosites on human protein structure and function. It serves as a platform for researchers seeking to analyse and interpret phosphosites or phosphoproteins within a structural, biophysical, and biological context.
The resource reuses public-domain data from leading international resources, including UniProtKB and the PDB. It also incorporates reprocessed mass spectrometry-based phosphoproteomics data from PRIDE/ProteomeXchange, a globally curated and internationally supported repository.
Scop3P Toolkit --------------
The Scop3P Toolkit is a collection of tools designed to explore and extend Scop3P functionalities, implemented as a Python-based Shiny application.
----
Using this Toolkit =================
This interactive tool launches a web-based environment containing three applications that extend the capabilities of Scop3P through the integration of Bio2Byte tools and interactive visualisation frameworks.
Peptide Mapper --------------
Map phosphopeptide coverage from *Scop3P* onto *AlphaFold2* structures for a given *UniProt* accession, and inspect peptide overlap and modification context.
1. Loads peptide and modification data from Scop3P. 2. Filters and selects peptide regions. 3. Maps selected regions onto AlphaFold structures. 4. Exports a styled HTML session.
Structure Visualisation -----------------------
Explore PTMs, disease-associated variants, structures, biophysical predictions, residue interaction networks, and structural alignments for a *UniProt* protein.
1. Retrieves PTMs and disease-associated variants. 2. Renders PDB or AlphaFold structures. 3. Runs Bio2Byte predictions and applies 3D colouring. 4. Builds residue interaction networks. 5. Performs TM-align structural comparisons.
Mutation Effect ---------------
Predict sequence-based biophysical properties for proteins using a *UniProt* ID and visualise the results through interactive plots. Users can introduce one or more amino acid mutations, recompute predictions for the mutated sequence, and directly compare wild-type and mutant profiles.
1. Retrieves the wild-type UniProt sequence and Scop3P PTMs. 2. Runs Bio2Byte tools to generate wild-type and mutant predictions. 3. Compares residue-level features between wild-type and mutant proteins. 4. Generates mutation-centred inference summaries.
-----

The *Scop3P Toolkit* has been developed by *CompOmics* (UGent), in collaboration with the *Bio2Byte* Lab (VUB) and the *VIB Data Core* team (VIB).
